name: Xtream Library (Dev)
description: EXPERIMENTAL: Sync Xtream VOD and Series content to native Jellyfin libraries via STRM files. Includes native tuner (may cause playback regression).
overview: Development channel for Xtream Library plugin. Contains experimental features like native tuner host. Add this manifest URL to test pre-release builds.

versions.changelog: Add multi-provider support: configure N Xtream providers each with its own credentials and library path. Providers sync sequentially to separate Jellyfin library folders. Provider selector bar in the config UI. Existing single-provider configs are auto-migrated on first startup. Note: first sync after upgrading will be a full sync.

Fix connection test crash when provider returns "N/A" for active_cons or max_connections: some Xtream providers send non-numeric strings for these user info fields, which now fall back to 0 instead of throwing a deserialization error (fixes #39).
Fix StringBoolConverter crash on integer values, channel mapping race condition during guide refresh, and add diagnostic logging
Handle Jellyfin hdhr_ channel ID remapping — map channel numbers back to stream IDs for correct playback
Fix channel routing — throw FileNotFoundException for non-owned channels so Jellyfin falls through to M3U tuner
Fix playback error for M3U tuner channels — return null from GetChannelStream for non-owned channels
Fix tuner crash for non-xtream channel IDs + HLS latency tuning for near-instant channel switching
HLS latency tuning - enable remux instead of full transcode for near-instant channel switching (<1s)
Add native tuner host for zero-probe Live TV - cuts channel switch time from ~6s to ~3s
